# Apple maturity external input

This directory contains a locally downloaded research dataset used only to bootstrap the item 5 computer-vision work.

- Source: [Mendeley Data, version 4](https://data.mendeley.com/datasets/gfcmdbvw65/4)
- DOI: `10.17632/gfcmdbvw65.4`
- License: CC BY 4.0
- Integrity and provenance: `MANIFEST.json`
- Extracted data: ignored by Git because the archive and images are external inputs

The dataset is not the production validation set. It comes from an external orchard and cannot establish performance for a different farm, cultivar, camera, season, or lighting condition. Any model trained with it remains blocked from agronomic recommendations until the pilot protocol and an independent local evaluation are completed.
